NONE: C1 not working or being used
› An idle moment or period of time is one in which there is no work or activity.

before noun: C2 [ before noun ] without any particular purpose

NONE: C2 UK lazy and not willing to work
› If an engine or machine idles, it runs slowly but does not move or do any work.

example: Half these factories now stand idle.
這些工廠如今有半數閒置。
It's crazy to have £7,000 sitting idle in the bank.
把7000英鎊閒置在銀行裡簡直是瘋了。
If you have an idle moment, call me.
如果你有空，給我打電話。
Almost half of the workforce are now idle.
近一半勞動力現在都沒有工作。
Synonym
unemployed
an idle glance
漫不經心的一瞥
This is no idle threat.
這絕不是隨口嚇唬人。
He's a very able student, he's just bone idle (= very lazy).
他是個能力很強的學生，只是太懶了。
He left the engine idling and ran into the shop.
他讓引擎空轉著，自己跑進了商店。

NONE: › to spend a period of time relaxing and doing very little

example: We idled away the hours drinking and playing cards.
我們喝酒、玩紙牌，消磨時間。

NONE: 無行動地，不活動地，不活躍地

example: I was just glancing idly through a magazine.
我只是在漫不經心地翻看雜誌。
She lay idly on the grass.
她懶洋洋地躺在草地上。
We cannot stand idly by while these people suffer.
這些人在受苦，我們不能袖手旁觀。
